cell_boundary_method: Estimated from midpoint distances between grid centers; outer edges extrapolated by half the nearest spacing.
intersection_method: Cell polygons intersected with the Guelma boundary in projected EPSG:32632.
aggregation_method: Area-weighted mean using cell intersection areas. Weights are renormalized over available valid cells.
important_limitations: NASA POWER grid-cell boundaries are estimated, not official.
AG and RE have different spatial grids.
Spatial resolution is too coarse for field-level decisions.
Area coverage should be reviewed before interpreting averages.
NASA POWER values are regional environmental context.
